articles.summary: ENERGY STORAGE DRIVES DOUBLE-DIGIT GROWTH; ORMAT RAISES MIDPOINT OF 2026 REVENUE AND ADJUSTED EBITDA GUIDANCE AND EXPANDS EGS PIPELINE POTENTIAL TO 5–6 GW HIGHLIGHTS STRONG ENERGY STORAGE PERFORMANCE DRIVES THIRD QUARTER RESULTS, WITH REVENUE UP 10.2%, NET INCOME ATTRIBUTABLE TO STOCKHOLDERS UP 32.2%, AND ADJUSTED EBITDA UP 11.1% ENERGY STORAGE SEGMENT CONTINUES TO DELIVER RECORD RESULTS, WITH REVENUE UP 145.2% YEAR-OVER-YEAR, DRIVEN BY FAVORABLE MERCHANT MARKET PRICING, HIGH AVAILABILITY, AND CONTRIBUTIONS FROM NEWLY ADDED CAPACITY ORMAT RAISES THE MIDPOINT OF ITS FULL YEAR REVENUE AND ADJUSTED EBITDA GUIDANCE CONTINUED PROGRESS IN NEXT-GENERATION GEOTHERMAL, ADVANCING TWO EGS PILOT PROGRAMS AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF ORMAT'S FIRST COMMERCIAL EGS PROJECT. RENO, Nev., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Ormat Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: ORA) (the “Company” or “Ormat”), a leading geothermal and renewable energy company, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30,
articles.title: Ormat Technologies Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
